description.narrative: The Project's impact will be the development of more mid-level and highly skilled human resources who will contribute to economic growth and social development. The Project supports the Government's poverty reduction strategy and economic goals by improving the country's skill-based competitiveness. The Project's envisioned outcome is improved access and strengthened capacity of the TEVT system in technical and technological education to meet labor market needs.

description.narrative: Improved access and strengthened capacity of the TEVT system in technical and technological education to address labor market needs.

No of degree programs (B.Tech.Ed. and B.Tech.) that do not require A/L qualifications for admissions developed. Progress/Status: Competencys standards and course outlines were developed for new degree programs. Data Source: MSDVTE EMIS data MoE data Actual value:

No of technical colleges (TCs) strengthened to enable them to become colleges of technology (CoTs) Progress/Status: 6 TCS have been promoted to the status of College of Technolgy through a Cabinet paper and actions are taken to strenthen the structure Data Source: Project completion report Actual value:

No of technician diploma programs in different technologies that do not require advanced level (A/L) qualifications for admission developed. Progress/Status: 11 comptency standards and course outlines were developed and foundations courses were commenced in 6 technology areas. Data Source: Project completion report Actual value:

Technical teacher education (B.Tech.Ed.) institutionalized with annual enrollment intake capacity of 300 full-time and 300 part-time students. Progress/Status: 28 students have enrolled in B.Tech.Ed program from 2008. Data Source: Project completion report Actual value:

Annual enrollment intake capacity of technician diploma programs increased from 600 to 1,500 full-time and 1,500 part-time students. Progress/Status: A total of 343 students in 6 CoTs are following foundation courses in diploma programs. Data Source: Project completion report Actual value:

100 technical education and vocational training (TEVT) teachers and trainers strengthened. Progress/Status: Will be assessed in due course. Data Source: Project completion report Base year: 2005 Baseline value: N

Annual enrollment intake capacity of 600 full-time and 600 part-time students in technologist programs (B.Tech.) developed. Progress/Status: Will be assessed in due course. Data Source: Project completion report Base year: 2005 Baseline value: N

The University of Vocational Technology (Univotec) established. Progress/Status: The Univotec Act was passed in the Parliament in June 2008. The Vice Chancellor and Interim Council was appointed. The first faculty of the Univotec is conducting its Bachelor degree program in Technical education. Data Source: MSDVTE EMIS data MoE data Base year: 2005 Baseline value: N
